description: This file defines the ResultSet class for 'Tag' entities within the Coocook schema, including methods for joining tags, filtering by names, and retrieving ungrouped tags.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Tag
classes.description: ResultSet class for handling collections of Tag objects, providing methods for joining, filtering by names, and retrieving ungrouped tags.

methods.name: joined
methods.description: Concatenates all 'name' column values in the result set into a single space-separated string.

methods.name: from_names
methods.description: Filters tags based on a space-separated string of names, returning tags whose names are in the list.

methods.name: ungrouped
methods.description: Retrieves tags that do not belong to any group (i.e., 'tag_group' is undefined).
